verdict.rationale: Docs reference 'View and enforce your data quality' and 'Ensure data quality' pages, implying some schema/data-quality enforcement capability, but no evidence describes the actual mechanism (flagging, blocking, or quarantining violating events) or how a tracking plan is defined and enforced.
